title: FastaGuard: FASTA preflight QC for modern bioinformatics pipelines
description: FastaGuard is a streaming-first Rust CLI for FASTA preflight quality control in assembly pipelines. It validates structure, flags FASTA-level red flags, and emits a stable HTML/JSON/TSV/MultiQC report contract with explicit pipeline gates before expensive downstream QC (QUAST, BUSCO, BlobToolKit, CheckM, annotation, or official validators). This Zenodo deposit archives a citable software release accompanying the Bioinformatics Application Note.
